# scratch-hello

Debug scratch profile `scratch.hello` (`conversations/workspace`): the smallest
scratch agent, for checking what one actually receives — no repo CLAUDE.md, the
user's own settings, exactly `scratch_hello_where` + `flag_raise` under `/mcp`.
Launch: `POST /api/conversations` with
`{"workspace":{"kind":"scratch","profile":"scratch.hello","input":{}},"prompt":"Describe your context."}`.
